# AzureStorage.DataLake

```m
AzureStorage.DataLake(endpoint as text, optional options as nullable record) as table
```

Returns a navigational table containing the documents found in the specified container and its subfolders from Azure Data Lake Storage.

*Description: Microsoft, MIT ([THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](../../../../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)).*

Reference: [Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/powerquery-m/azurestorage-datalake)

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Optional |
|---|---|---|
| `endpoint` | `text` | no |
| `options` | `nullable record` | yes |
